name: ledger-app
description: Production-grade full-stack financial ledger and money transfer application

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix backend run test:unit && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
